contract: GRPCRoute rule and backend RequestHeaderModifier, including repeated binary metadata and weighted ReferenceGrant transitions

standard.cloudBoundary: Live API and etcd in dedicated disposable kind, installed Octavia WSGI/SQL, Amphora driver renderer, native HAProxy and grpcio. Keystone, Neutron, Octavia RPC completion and Amphora agent transport are fixtures.
standard.backendBoundary: Two live grpcio h2c origins, reached through fixture-managed selectorless Services and EndpointSlices with distinct member ports.
